diabase.definition:
n. A basic, dark-colored, holocrystalline, igneous rock,
   consisting essentially of a triclinic feldspar and pyroxene with
   magnetic iron; -- often limited to rocks pretertiary in age. It
   includes part of what was early called greenstone.
diabase.translation:
n. 辉绿岩
[化] 辉绿岩

diabatic.definition: a involving a transfer of heat

diabeta.translation: [网络] 达安疗；优降糖；格列本脲

diabetes.definition: n. a polygenic disease characterized by abnormally high glucose levels in the blood; any of several metabolic disorders marked by excessive urination and persistent thirst
diabetes.translation:
n. 糖尿病, 多尿症
[医] 糖尿病; 多尿症

diabetes decipiens.translation: [医] 隐蔽性糖尿病(无多尿多饮的糖尿病)

diabetes inositus.translation: [医] 肌糖性糖尿病, 肌糖尿

diabetes mosler's.translation: [医] 莫斯勒氏糖尿病(肌醇性糖尿病)

diabetes of bearded women.translation: [医] 有须妇女糖尿病, 多毛妇女糖尿病

diabetic.definition:
n. someone who has diabetes
a. of or relating to or causing diabetes
s. suffering from diabetes
diabetic.translation:
a. 糖尿病的
n. 糖尿病患者

diabetic glomerulosclerosis.translation: [医] 糖尿病性肾小球硬化症

diabetic puncture.translation: [医] 糖尿穿刺, 伯纳尔氏穿刺

diabetic sugar.translation: [医] 糖尿病糖(糖尿病者尿中的葡萄糖)

diabetics.translation: n. 糖尿病患者( diabetic的复数形式 )

diabetogenic hormone.translation: [医] 致糖尿激素, 生糖尿激素

diabetologists.translation: (diabetologist 的复数) n.糖尿病专家

diablerie.translation: n. 魔鬼行为, 妖术,开玩笑

diablo.translation: n. 暗黑破坏神（游戏名）

diabo.translation: [地名] [布基纳法索、科特迪瓦] 贾博
